(a) You might enjoy spending a quiet morning sketching along the riverbank in the local park, capturing the play of light and shadow on the water. (b) You might enjoy spending a quiet morning hiking along the forest trails near the outskirts of town, listening to the gentle rustle of leaves and birdsong. (c) You might enjoy spending a quiet morning browsing the shelves of a neighborhood bookstore, letting your thoughts wander between the novels and poetry collections. (d) You might enjoy spending a quiet morning visiting a peaceful spot you love, such as a park or garden, letting the sights and sounds help you unwind. Bring along a warm drink and perhaps a small notebook to note down any thoughts that come to you. It’s a lovely way to both clear your mind and savor the breathing space of the weekend.
